name: @mymehq/integration-readwise
description: Inbound Readwise highlights + books connector. Schedule trigger polls Readwise's Export API on an hourly cron and lands highlights as `readwise.highlight` items with parent `readwise.book` items linked by `parent-of` edges. Token-credential install (kind: api_token, auth_scheme: Token) — Readwise's REST API requires `Authorization: Token <key>`.
